title: feature_snapshot
description: Frozen model inputs for one mortgage, deal cycle and cutoff time. A snapshot is immutable per snapshot_id. INV-2: every input has both its event time and its ingestion time at or before cutoff_at. Observed outcomes are not in this table.
x-grain: One row per mortgage_id + cycle_id + cutoff_at + feature_version.

snapshot_id.description: Deterministic hash of mortgage_id, cycle_id, cutoff_at and feature_version.

snapshot_kind.description: checkpoint = deal_end_at minus 90 days. A live snapshot never replaces the checkpoint snapshot.

source_watermark.description: JSON object: dataset name to the latest ingestion time at or before cutoff_at, or null.

evidence_ids.description: Source record IDs behind the main signals.

borrower_count.description: Approved linked borrowers at the cutoff.

pt_request_started.description: A product-transfer request exists at the cutoff.

pt_days_at_current_stage.description: Days the latest open request has stayed at its current stage. Null when no request is open.

pt_failed_attempts_30d.description: Request events with status error or rejected in the 30 days before the cutoff.

pt_failed_ratio_30_90.description: pt_failed_attempts_30d / pt_failed_attempts_90d. Null when the 90-day count is zero.

pt_software_errors_90d.description: Renewal-portal software faults in the 90 days before the cutoff.

pt_unrecovered_software_error.description: The latest software fault was not followed by a stage advance before the cutoff.

svc_open_cases_at_cutoff.description: Cases whose reconstructed status at the cutoff is unresolved. Excludes payment-difficulty cases.

svc_contacts_30d.description: Distinct contact_id values. Case state changes are not contacts.

svc_contact_trend.description: Contacts in the last 30 days minus the monthly average of days 31 to 90.

svc_repeat_contacts_unresolved.description: Sum over cases unresolved at the cutoff of (contacts - 1).

ctx_payment_feed_watermark.description: Context, not a recommended refinancing input. Latest payment-feed ingestion at or before the cutoff.

ctx_payment_feed_stale.description: T03: true when the payment feed is missing or more than 72 hours older than the cutoff.

ctx_missed_payments_180d.description: Null when the payment feed is stale. A missing feed is not zero arrears.

ctx_arrears_amount.description: Null when the payment feed is stale.

ctx_payment_support_open.description: INV-1 routing context: an unresolved payment-support case exists at the cutoff. Not a refinancing label.
